title: Nuclear Regulator Calls for Stronger Leadership
summary: The Office for Nuclear Regulation reported that the nuclear sector remains safe and secure but called for improved leadership and cyber security maturity.

title: Department of Transport Cancels 16 Road Schemes
summary: The UK Department for Transport has cancelled 16 road schemes that were under consideration as recently as July 2025.

title: Neso Buys 1.2GW via Interconnector Over Asset Delay
summary: The National Energy System Operator purchased 1.2GW of electricity from a French interconnector after a National Grid asset return was delayed.

title: ORE Catapult Framework Aims to Cut Floating Wind Costs
summary: The Offshore Renewable Energy Catapult has released a framework designed to help developers reduce the costs of floating offshore wind projects.

title: DNA Recording System Tracks Embryo Cell Development
summary: Scientists used a DNA recording system to trace mouse embryo development from two cells into organ formation, revealing individual cell lineage.

title: Network Rail and IET Celebrate Female Engineers for Ada Lovelace Day
summary: Network Rail highlighted two female engineers and the IET announced finalists for its Young Woman Engineer awards.

title: Fortastra Secures $30M Series A for In-Orbit Security Spacecraft
summary: Space defence company Fortastra raised $30 million to develop manoeuvrable spacecraft for multi-orbit security coverage.

title: Fiat Multiplay Concept Transforms From MPV to Pickup
summary: Fiat's new Multiplay concept vehicle can transform from a family MPV into a pickup truck.

title: Physicists Recreate Quantum Effect to Stop Particle Movement
summary: Oxford physicists used a hybrid quantum computer to demonstrate a quantum effect that completely halts a particle's movement.

title: Wireflow and Pickering Form Testblox AB for In-Fixture Testing
summary: Swedish PCB test company Wireflow partnered with Pickering Interfaces to launch Testblox AB for automated test modules.

title: AMD Launches Open Helion Rack Blueprint for Agentic AI
summary: AMD introduced an open Helion rack blueprint supporting CPU-only and combined CPU-GPU configurations for agentic AI.

title: Cellid Joins Qualcomm Snapdragon START Program
summary: Cellid joined Qualcomm's Snapdragon START program with a reference design combining its waveguide and display technologies with the Snapdragon AR1+ Gen 1.

title: Eryri National Park Authority Quashes Hydroelectric Dam Approval
summary: The Eryri National Park Authority quashed its planning approval for a hydroelectric dam following pressure from campaigners.

title: MicroLED Market Divides Into Three Distinct Sectors
summary: Yole reports that the microLED market is splitting into three distinct families driven by AR, optical I/O, and other applications.

title: Lockheed Unveils PAC-3 Edge Interceptor for Hypersonic Threats
summary: Lockheed Martin introduced the PAC-3 Edge variant, featuring an improved motor to engage hypersonic glide vehicles and advanced aerial threats.

title: Scientists Discover Hidden Spinning Property in Light
summary: Researchers uncovered that light can naturally develop spinning and twisting behavior while traveling through empty space.

title: Review Highlights Recent Immunoglobulin G1 Engineering Strategies
summary: A review details recent engineering strategies involving IgG scaffolds, Fc fragments, and domain fusions for antibody-based therapeutics.

title: Carbon-Dot Interface Enables Dielectrics on 2D Semiconductors
summary: Researchers demonstrated an atomically thin carbon-dot monolayer assembly that enables deposition of high-kappa oxide on 2D semiconductors.

title: On-Chip Monitors Detect Bit-Flip Attacks in AI Accelerators
summary: Researchers published a method for AI hardware resilience using built-in performance monitors to detect bit-flip attacks in deep neural networks.

title: Deterministic Nucleation Enables Controlled Growth of 2D Semiconductors
summary: Researchers published a paper detailing spatially deterministic nucleation of 2D semiconductors using an etching flux to control crystalline material formation.

title: NASA Seeks Solutions for Lunar Static Electricity Risks
summary: NASA is asking for ideas to prevent static electricity from zapping astronauts and critical hardware during moon missions.

title: Sixfab Launches AI HAT+ for Raspberry Pi 5
summary: Sixfab introduced the AI HAT+ for Raspberry Pi 5, a third-party accelerator board featuring the DEEPX DX-M1M NPU.

title: Ofcom and JOINER Partner on Satellite Spectrum Study
summary: Ofcom and the JOINER Platform agreed to collaborate on providing technical evidence for future satellite spectrum policies.

title: General Fusion Reaches Magnetised Heating Milestone
summary: General Fusion's LM26 experiment achieved electron temperatures above 12 million degrees Celsius, verified by the UKAEA.

title: Populous to Lead London Stadium Redevelopment Study
summary: Populous has been chosen to lead a study exploring development and leisure opportunities around the London Stadium.

title: Thermoprocessing Solutions for Tungsten Powder Carburization
summary: A review of reaction mechanisms and automated high-temperature furnace engineering solutions for carburizing tungsten powder highlights ways to improve efficiency.
